_comment: THE ONE LIST OF STACK NAMES. Every CloudFormation stack this app creates is <instance prefix><name>. bin/backend.ts names its stacks through lib/config/stack-names.ts, which reads this file; scripts/lib/stack-lookup.cjs reads it to tell this instance's stacks from another's; scripts/teardown.mjs reads current and retired alike. a-stack-belongs-to-its-own-instance.test.ts keeps `current` equal to the stacks bin and the capability registry create, and retired-stack-names-are-refused.test.ts refuses a retired name anywhere in backend/ and tests/ but here.
_testOnly: Opt-in stacks the e2e suite reads, never part of a production deployment.
_perRegion: One stack per region an image model is pinned to, <name><region> (ImageGuardrail-us-west-2). `crossRegions` lists those regions, so teardown looks there too; teardown-plan.test.ts keeps it equal to the regions the image-model registry pins.
_retired: Names earlier layouts gave their stacks. No code creates or reads them; teardown enumerates them so an instance deployed before the re-layout is removed whole.
_retiredPerClassification: Per-classification names of earlier layouts (Classification-Basic, Tier-Premium).
